summary: Mission starts and approved launch runs resolve workspaces for their execution members: remote paths must be explicit and absolute and are published unchanged, while local-only runs retain canonicalized cwd defaults.

compatibility.detail: No wire or declaration changes. CLI callers starting remote runtimes, executable gates, or referenced missions must pass an absolute --workspace instead of relying on the publisher cwd.

downtime.detail: No service restart required beyond normal deployment.

manual.detail: No data migration; supply --workspace when starting remote execution.

recovery.detail: Existing runs are unchanged. A refused start publishes no run; correct the workspace and start again.

schema.detail: No stored schema or migration change.
